purpose: Project live Defence runtime health and incident evidence into cause-aware operational attention without changing any raw health, incident, admission or estate state.
rules: A confirmed shared transport cycle has at least the minimum target count, no non-transport failures, and a transport-failure fraction at or above the confirmed threshold.
A shared transport cluster has at least the minimum target count and no non-transport failures but is below the confirmed shared fraction.
Cluster recovery requires a later complete all-pass Railway probe cycle with at least as many observed targets.
A degraded or unhealthy target is residual-shared only when all failed probe samples in its current health window belong to shared transport cycles.
A target with both shared-cycle failures and failures outside shared cycles is mixed_or_unresolved.
A target with failures only outside shared cycles is target_specific.
Non-health estate problems remain separate operational attention and are never relabelled as transport failures.
The projection never changes raw estate state, health observations, incident state, release admission, rollback recommendation or source truth.
invariants: Raw health evidence is immutable and preserved.
Raw estate state is returned unchanged and is never overridden by attribution.
Recovered shared events may remain visible while conservative health windows retain failed samples.
No automatic retry, restart, rollback, health-window rewrite, incident suppression or evidence deletion is authorised.
This runtime operational attention projection remains separate from the human review/certification attention queue.
Browser roles receive no EXECUTE grant.
